finding: No test covers the two new halves of _is_line_note: a position-only note in note-list, and a DiffNote with no position in thread-list.
why: Dropping either half of the predicate leaves every test green.
fix: Add one case for each half.

finding: _is_line_note decides on-a-line by type or position, but change_comment decides it by type alone.
why: A create answer with a position and no type counts as degraded, and with require_inline the port would delete a comment that landed on a line.

finding: _is_draft reads only the draft key, but change-view also treats work_in_progress and a Draft: title as a draft.
why: If glab's JSON has no draft key, change-update-body answers false and never restores the flag, while change-view says draft. Whether a supported GitLab omits the key is unverified.
fix: Share one draft predicate between _normalize and _is_draft.
